integrity: The general statement is supported by a symbolic order-theoretic proof. Exhaustive computations are reported only as finite cross-checks. Literature comparisons are statement-level and residual terminology risk is disclosed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to equal heights at least three, all levels of size at least two, and unequal level-size vectors. No full homotopy type is asserted for the non-isolated mapping-space component, and finite enumeration is only a check, not a proof.
title: Off-diagonal homotopy rigidity for finite weak-order pseudospheres
